The upper lines (THE……KEY, TO……SUCCESS) open gaping word gaps that break the slab into scattered words, at both 1440 and 360. The composition also declares `hero_zone: lower-third`, but at 1440 the monument sits in the upper half with no calm field above it. Force-justify every line, STABILITY included, so it reads as one carved slab, and anchor the block to the lower third of the gold field.

3. **(5) The ledger shows placeholder copy.** Both sports rows read "VS OPPONENT · WIN" and "VS OPPONENT · LOSS". Name the actual opponent, or drop the line and keep only the result word.

1. (Judgment 3) The declaration asks for a dense, justified slab with STABILITY as the full-width closing line. The mockup fakes the justification with extreme letter-spacing instead. "I S E M O T I O N A L" and "S T A B I L I T Y" fall apart into loose letters at 1440 and at 360, so the crowded rectangle is gone. Scale each line so it fills the measure at normal tracking: STABILITY set largest, IS EMOTIONAL next. That gives the solid block the brief describes.
2. (Judgment 5) The Spaceman entry reads "Design and engineering decided under one roof, shipping through the hard parts." The deck reads "Ten years running a studio alone." Neither is in the records. The record says Spaceman is the LLC he has operated under for the past decade, "sometimes as a solo contributor, sometimes embedded in a larger team," and "alone" contradicts that. Replace both with wording drawn from the record's approach and outcome text.
